## Type of Change

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for all changed behavior
- [ ] `bundle exec rails test` passes with no failures

- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under `[Unreleased]`

- [ ] Commit messages follow the conventional commit format (`feat(scope): description`)
